must_not: A half-saved Gym list record, typed text lost without a warning, or the app closing

note: The save sends every form field, so a second device with older values can write over a newer change

start: A member's page (signed in as front-desk staff)

steps.action: Tap "Edit"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Edit member" with every saved detail filled in
The saved country code and number (a +971 member opens as +971)
Buttons "Cancel" and "Save changes"
No photo row
must_not: A non-Indian number shown as +91
Empty boxes for details that were saved
The "Can train at every branch" box shown to a staff login

steps.action: Change the name and the emergency number, tap "Save changes"

A second member made
